messages.subject: Renewable Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kelby,

Your executive-search work across renewable energy, sustainable infrastructure, power and industrial leadership aligns well with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where infrastructure growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
